subject: Renewal amendment: add 8 GPUs, dedicated pool fencing & throughput SLAs
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmerobotics.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity expansion questions

Hi Priyom,

Our renewal window is coming up in mid-Apr and we want to add reserved capacity for our inference workload. High level: we9d like to reserve an additional 8x A100-class GPUs, and we need tenant separation so our inference jobs do not see cross-tenant noisy neighbors. Also asking about a throughput SLA for peak shipment processing (we expect bursts up to 4M tokens/day).

Can you outline how Redwood would document tenant fencing and what throughput guarantees look like if we commit to a 12-month term? Also please include any changes to billing cadence or amendments we should expect.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Liu
Head of ML Ops, Acme Robotics

Sara,

Thanks — this is straightforward to handle in an amendment. High-level proposal: add 8 dedicated A100-equivalent GPUs in a reserved pool, enable logical tenant fencing (isolated dedicated pool + network egress rules + KV prefix isolation) and a billing amendment that spreads the upfront reservation over the 12-month term with an optional monthly invoice. We can offer a 99.5% throughput availability target for the reserved pool and an operational runbook for failover to a compatible shared fallback with throttles (only used as last resort).

I9ll run this by our infra/comms team for confirmation of the fencing details and a simple runbook we can attach to the amendment. Draft amendment and pricing attached for initial review. If this looks good I9ll schedule a 30-minute sync to finalize wording and timelines.

Team,

Looping you both in — Acme wants +8 GPUs and explicit tenant separation for their reserved pool as part of the renewal amendment. Key asks:
- Logical isolation: dedicated reserved pool isolated from multi-tenant pools (no shared KV prefixes, separate model cache).
- Network fencing: egress rules, VPC endpoints, and IP allowlists.
- Throughput SLA: they9re asking for a guarantee for bursts up to ~4M tokens/day; propose we offer a 99.5% availability target for the pool with burst buffer configuration documented.

Can you confirm feasibility and a short ops playbook (what we run during incident, contact list, escalation windows) I can attach to the amendment? Also call out any lead time (days) to provision the 8 GPUs and whether we need a maintenance window to apply fence rules.

I9ve attached the draft amendment.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: need validation on tenant fencing + throughput SLA for Acme renewal (DEAL-ACME-2027-07)

Priyom / Karthik,

We can provide the isolation and SLA requested. Summary of confirmation and caveats below:

1) Provisioning lead time:
- 8 A100-equivalent GPUs: 10 business days from signed amendment if hitting standard capacity; 18 business days if we funnel through partner region inventory.

2) Isolation approach (what the runbook will document):
- Dedicated reserved pool (physical allocation) + software-level tenant fencing: isolated KV namespaces, strict cache partitioning, and modelfile ACLs.
- Network: VPC peering + IP allowlist + egress ACLs. No cross-tenant routing permitted.
- Monitoring and tracing: per-tenant token throughput meter; alerts at 85/95/99% thresholds of provisioned throughput.

3) Throughput SLA:
- We can offer a throughput availability SLA of 99.5% for sustained daily throughput up to 4M tokens/day. For burst protection beyond that, we will document explicit burst buffer behaviors and a fallback to pre-agreed throttling profiles.

4) Operational runbook deliverables (we will attach these):
- isolation-runbook-v2.pdf (how to validate fencing, rollback steps)
- network-fencing-checklist.xlsx (pre-provision checklist)
- contact list and escalation ladder (on-call rotation + exec on-call)

5) Maintenance window:
- Minor config changes (apply ACLs): can be done live with no customer downtime, but recommend a 1-hour window for validation. Any physical node moves require a 2-hour window.

6) Billing/pricing note:
- Reservation pricing shown in your draft amortizes over 12 months. If Acme prefers upfront prepay we can offer a 4% discount; monthly invoicing keeps their cashflow smoother.

I9ll attach the runbook and checklist to this thread — happy to walk through with the Acme ML Ops team.

-Neha
Director, Production Infrastructure
